sources.text: JR and Maria are the best!! I ended my 6-day trip to New York with the Big Bus Tour, and it was honestly the perfect way to wrap things up! The guide was amazing — super friendly, gave clear and interesting explanations about every spot, and made the whole ride so much fun. The driver was also excellent — smooth, safe, and professional. I really enjoyed every minute of it. Thank you for making my last day in New York such a memorable one! Great guided tour from Midtown Manhattan to Dumbo and back. Shelley and Manny took great care of us. Great photo opportunities and Shelly help you with all your photos. Also excellent insight about the city history and fun facts. Highly recommended! 4.7 out of 5 · 19,429 reviews

description.value: Open-air bus tour candidates start with Big Bus Tours. Wikipedia describes the company as an operator of open top bus sightseeing tours, and says it operates in 28 cities of 18 countries with 444 buses operating around the world. Typically, Big Bus Tours use open top double-decker buses in burgundy and cream-coloured livery, and New York is one of its listed cities. Check the current New York route map and ticket prices on the operator's site before booking.
